questions.prompt: What is the main thing you want from this match or session?
Which other goals matter, and how should they rank below the primary goal?
When should the coach treat a fight as necessary rather than optional?
examples: enemy is close enough to attack
objective cannot be completed without fighting

questions.prompt: Do you want to hunt fights, avoid optional fights, or fight only when they come to you?
options: fight when a nearby threat forces it

questions.prompt: When a forced fight becomes unfavorable, what should the coach prefer?
options: take one safe exchange then retreat

questions.prompt: How technical should the coaching language be?

persistence_contract.default_unfavorable_policy: take one safe exchange then retreat when damage or lost position threatens extraction
